reviewSamples.author: Jaclyn Gilley
reviewSamples.text: I have been seeing Natasha for over 5 years now and I always tell people she is truly incredible! I was recommend to her by my previous massage therapist who was moving and going to her was one of the best choices I made. I dealt with major back, foot and shoulder issues and seeing Natasha has made them very manageable. I always say, I feel like her hands were blessed because she truly has helped to heal me! I have recommended countless friends and family and they love her too. It's always a positive and healing experience when I see her. Cannot recommend enough!

reviewSamples.author: Alix Kissinger
reviewSamples.text: I've had massages regularly in the past, but never one like this. Natasha combines her gifts and her knowledge to transport you to a place of relaxtion, peace and healing. I immediately felt comfortable and "at home" in her cozy space. She's professional, extremely skilled at reading the body, and is intentional in her practice. I left feeling seen and cared for on a level I've never found at other establishments and I will recommend Natasha to anyone and everyone!

reviewSamples.author: Brian Asheland
reviewSamples.text: Natasha did a phenomenal job on my shoulder, which has been suffering from repetitive stress issues. So relaxing, calming and magical, for the first time in months I slept without shoulder pain.

reviewSamples.author: Virginia Bond
reviewSamples.text: I met Natasha at a shop and fell in love with her. She had availability to give me a full hour of Cranial Sacral Biodynamic and I took her up on it. It was magical. I work a lot and these types of modalities help me tremendously. My first time having this done. Thank you Natasha. I highly recommend her.

reviewSamples.author: bailey daigle
reviewSamples.text: Natasha truly works magic. From start to finish, I felt comfortable, calm, and completely cared for. She seemed to know what my body needed before I could even put it into words, matching the preferred pressure perfectly and moving with such intuition. It was as if she spoke my body's language, gently releasing places that had been tense and closed off for years.
